title: Best Street Photography Camera (2026)
summary: We're still testing and researching this guide. Picks will be added soon.
method: Selected from PCMag’s 2026 point‑and‑shoot list and Rtings’ street‑photography guide, both of which recommend the Fujifilm X100VI.
assumptions: No price information was provided in the sources, so price details are omitted.

verdict.line: The X100VI is ideal for street photographers who need a compact, high‑quality camera with a fast lens and silent shutter. It offers a large sensor and excellent low‑light performance, making it a solid choice for city scenes. The main catch is its higher price point compared to entry‑level point‑and‑shoots.
